svg.title: The Terms-Sale Land Operation
svg.desc: diagram id: diag-06-terms-seller-architecture; chapter number: 11; chart type: org_architecture; title: The Terms-Sale Land Operation; subtitle: Buyers as the asset, notes as the cash engine; caption: Abhi runs roughly 80% of sales on terms, so buyer acquisition, payoff nudges, compliance, and listing media orbit the note book rather than a one-time cash sale.; assumptions note: Spoke roles group practices reported by the cited practitioners; team headcount was not reported in testimony.; note: Attributed to Abhi of Gokce Capital via REtipster (HpkNhY7WclQ), Seth Williams of REtipster (m1GoTr9J5TM), William Bronchick (ZGvGq-_10yA), and Wyman Gentry (ItWPpkhNHto).; center: role: Terms-Sale Land Operator (Abhi, Gokce Capital); headcount: Not reported in testimony; focus: 80% terms / 20% cash across nearly 800 land deals since 2018; buy around $10K, sell around $20K with 10% down and about $500 a month.; spokes: role: Buyer Acquisition; type: Marketing; kpi: Cost per lead up from about $5 to $800-$1,200; role: Early-Payoff Cashback; type: In-house team; kpi: 5% back within 6 months, 2.5% within 12; about 10% of borrowers take it; reminders in months 4-5 and 9-11; role: Seller-Finance Compliance; type: Advisory; kpi: Owner-occupant deals counted per person against RMLO thresholds (Texas 5, Colorado 3, California 0); no-build-before-payoff clause; role: Drone Listing Media; type: Contractor; kpi: $125 for 5 photos, $225 for 10; Part 107 certified
